meanings.costs_realised_usdt: same value as costs_usdt, named for symmetry with costs_total_usdt
meanings.costs_usdt: realised cost of closed trades only: execution + entry + exit commissions. Unchanged since 003B; it does NOT include open positions.
meanings.entry_commissions_accrued_open_usdt: entry commissions of positions still open: charged at close by the broker, but already owed and already withheld from marked equity
meanings.execution_costs_realised_usdt: spread/impact cost embedded in closed-trade fills
meanings.pnl_realised_usdt: net PnL of closed trades (same value as net_realised_usdt)
meanings.pnl_unrealised_usdt: open positions marked at the last observable close, net of accrued entry commissions

lifecycle.invariant: generated == FILLED + CLOSED + BLOCKED_BY_RISK + GATED + REJECTED

opinion_accounting.invariant: generated == FILLED + CLOSED + BLOCKED_BY_RISK + GATED + REJECTED
